title: [E16-09] Tenant Isolation and Object Reference Security Tests
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-09 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As a security lead, I want to test tenant isolation and insecure object references, so I can protect buyers and artisans.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Test / Validation  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-039  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:B`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** [E01-11](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/39), [E16-05](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/78)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E01-11, E16-05.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Cross-tenant access denied in automated tests.
- [ ] Test list/detail/create/update/download authorization across two organizations and artisan identities.
- [ ] Cover nested IDs, association delegation, role changes and admin scopes.
- [ ] Verify denials reveal no protected payload and produce no unauthorized mutation.
- [ ] Confirm commerce exposes no individual wearable read path.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Maintain integration negative tests against real authorization/query layers rather than only mocked guards.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Substitute object IDs and revoke delegation mid-session; run browser/direct API tests and inspect denied requests for data leakage.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
